title: Constructionman
raw_text:
Job Title                                                                                                                       Job Code
Constructionman                                                                                                                 002688
Job Family                                 NOC                 Short Title (30 Characters)                      Short Title (14 Characters)
Construction and Extraction                TBD                 CONSTRUCTIONMAN                                  CONSTRUCTMAN
Pay Plan               Career Field        Other Relationships and Rules
Enlisted               CN                  N/A
Job Description
Constructionmen (CN) perform tasks directly related to the seven construction ratings during all phases of construction; assist in the preparation and
completion of construction projects at the crew member level and support facilities/equipment maintenance and repairs; maintain individual
expeditionary combat readiness at the fire team level; and assist in tasks required in combat and disaster preparedness or Humanitarian Assistance
Disaster Recovery (HADR) operations.

DoD Relationship                                               O*NET Relationship
Group Title                   DoD Code                 Occupation Title                       SOC Code             Job Family
Construction General          171000                   Helpers, Construction Trades, All      47-3019.00           Construction and Extraction
                                                       Other

Skills                                                                          Abilities
Critical Thinking                                                               Written Comprehension
Management of Material Resources                                                Inductive Reasoning
Judgment and Decision Making                                                    Problem Sensitivity
Reading Comprehension                                                           Manual Dexterity
Active Learning                                                                 Information Ordering
Equipment Selection                                                             Written Expression
Writing                                                                         Category Flexibility
Active Listening                                                                Deductive Reasoning
Complex Problem Solving                                                         Dynamic Strength
Mathematics                                                                     Finger Dexterity

                                                  CONSTRUCTION OPERATIONS
Paygrade             Task Type             Task Statements
E3                   CORE                  Convert standard U.S. weights and measures to the metric system
E3                   CORE                  Interpret construction sketches and diagrams
E3                   CORE                  Inventory tool kits, building materials, and repair parts
E3                   NON-CORE              Perform required maintenance (R1) and prestart check inspections
E3                   NON-CORE              Record discrepancies on trouble reports
E3                   CORE                  Use basic hand tools
E3                   NON-CORE              Utilize trip tickets (Motor Vehicle Utilization Record, DD Form 1970)

                                                                      SAFETY
Paygrade             Task Type             Task Statements
E3                   CORE                  Assist in the cleanup of minor Hazardous Material (HAZMAT) spills
E3                   CORE                  Employ Operational Risk Management (ORM) procedures
E3                   CORE                  Employ Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
E3                   CORE                  Handle Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT)
E3                   CORE                  Know how to read and identify Safety Data Sheet (SDS)




                                                                         CN-5
                                    SAFETY (CONT’D)
Paygrade   Task Type   Task Statements
E3         CORE        Report safety hazards and violations
E3         CORE        Store Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) as per Safety Data Sheet (SDS)

                               SEABEE COMBAT SKILLS
Paygrade   Task Type   Task Statements
E3         NON-CORE    Perform duties of ammunition carrier for Crew-Served Weapons (CSW)




                                              CN-6

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
